title: GivenConsentResponse
description: A consent given for a customer

changedAt.description: When the consent was last changed. ISO 8601 date format

consentChoice.description: Whether this consent has been approved or rejected.

consentId.description: The id of the consent defining what the customer has consented.

countryCode.description: The telephone number country code provided with the consent

createdAt.description: When the consent was given. ISO 8601 date format

createdByOrgId.description: The organisation through which the consent was given

customerNumber.description: Customer number. Entur number unique across organisations

customerRef.description: Customer reference. External reference, unique within an organisation

distributionChannel.description: Distribution channel through which the consent was given.

email.description: The contact email provided with the consent.

expirationDate.description: When the consent expires. ISO 8601 date format

fromStopPlace.description: The stop place where the customer’s journey started, in NeTEx format.

id.description: Unique id for the given consent.

lineRef.description: Reference to the customers journey line, in NeTEx format

originalDatedServiceJourneyId.description: Unique Id for a specific Service Journey, in NeTEx format

telephoneNumber.description: The telephone number provided with the consent

toStopPlace.description: The stop place where the customer’s journey ended, in NeTEx format.

changedAt.description: When the consent base was last changed. ISO 8601 date format

consentCode.description: Consent code used to identify the consent base

consentOwnerOrgId.description: The organisation that owns the consent base. If not set, the consent base can be used by all organisations.

createdAt.description: When the consent base was created. ISO 8601 date format

internalDescription.description: Internal description, describing the use cases for the consent base

orgNameSubstitutionPattern.description: The pattern on which to perform substitution within terms. Facilitates reusable consent basess across organisations

terms.description: Consent terms with long and short description in multiple languages. The descriptions can contain MarkDown

validFrom.description: If set, the date the consent base is valid from. It is not possible to change the consent terms after this date without creating a new version. If not set, the consent base is in draft mode.

validTo.description: If set, the date the consent base is valid to. If this date is in the past, the consent base is deactivated. If not set, the consent is active from validFrom and onwards.

changedAt.description: When the consent was last changed. ISO 8601 date format

createdAt.description: When the consent was created. ISO 8601 date format

isEmailSupported.description: Whether the organisation supports email as a contact method

isSmsSupported.description: Whether the organisation supports SMS as a contact method

organisationId.description: The organisation the consent is valid for.

validFrom.description: If set, the date the consent is valid from. Can only be set to a date after consent base validFrom. If not set, the consent base is in draft mode.

validTo.description: If set, the date the consent is valid to. Set the date to deactivate the consent. Can only be set to a date before the consent base validTo. If not set the consent is active from validFrom and forever after.

ConsentResponse.description: Consent response, includes the consent base

fullDescription.description: Text describing the terms in detail. The text can contain MarkDown

shortDescription.description: Short text explaining the terms. The text can contain MarkDown

ConsentTermsResponse.description: Text for terms in a specific language

description.description: A description for the partner administrating consents

InternalDescriptionResponse.description: Contains internal description for a consent. Will not be shown to customer
